text: This report recommends that the name "Rosie Ienco Lane" be approved to identify an existing public Lane bounded by Harbord Street, Manning Avenue, Bloor Street West and Clinton Street. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Rosie Ienco Lane" for the Lane bounded by Harbord Street, Manning Avenue, Bloor Street West and Clinton Street.
